newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mobil restarts refinery, on-spec by end of week.
newsitem.headline: Mobil restarts refinery, on-spec by end of week.

text.p: Mobil Oil Singapore said on Tuesday it has restarted its 300,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery and is expected to produce on-specification products by the end of this week.

"Mobil Oil Singapore announced that it had begun the process of starting up its refinery over the weekend," the company said in a statement. "The refinery is expected to be manufacturing its full range of on-spec products by the end of this week."
A Mobil spokesman said the refining capacity has been boosted to 300,000 bpd from 280,000 bpd before its scheduled regular maintenance which began on March 15.
A 500,000-tonne-per-year petrochemical complex was also shut during the maintenence.
The refinery has been scheduled to restart on April 21-23 and there were talks last week that the start-up would be delayed due to three mishaps during maintenance works in late March.
Of the three accidents reported at the refinery, a gas leak at the petrochemical complex was most serious, leading to two deaths and a suspension of maintenance works for two days.
